propositions: Network-capable git calls in gerrit_client.py and workspace.py lack explicit timeouts and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
Unhandled subprocess.TimeoutExpired in gerrit_client.py escapes token-redaction logic, creating a credential-disclosure path via TimeoutExpired.cmd
Two of six originally-identified call sites in _ref_lock.py are already structurally bounded by required keyword-only timeout parameter and need no edits
Two deferred call sites in _commands/init.py and _commands/fsck_repair.py are blocked by parallel task 01e8 and split to task 983f, not dropped
A 300-second timeout bound matches the cold-fetch profile of gerrit_client and workspace, avoiding false positives from legitimate large RPC operations on fresh clones
